evidence.observation: Verbatim: "| D5 | GO3 refuses by type first, then other outcomes, a preview without rows, the before model, rows that are not the operations in order | a dict cannot be asked for its digest; review GO3–GO5 F1 | GO3 spec §14, the evolution contract |". The listed refusals cover identity and binding, but not a before model outside the JSON data model. narrow_proposal (src/gnd/discover/narrow.py:47-54) checks the digest, then _before_document (narrow.py:85-90) returns json_document(parse_model_document(before_model.text.encode("utf-8"), source="model.orm.yaml")), and json_document raises ModelValueError (src/gnd/model/_documents.py:13-17, 27-61) for a YAML-only value. Reachable input: a preview refused at the current-model gate still writes the requested report (src/gnd/evolve/cli_service.py:736, 557-570; service.py:1778-1783 with stage="current-model", before_text set at service.py:1720-1723), so a workspace model that parses but fails validation on, say, a date value produces a report whose rows are all unassessed (service.py:454-481); narrow keeps every operation and escapes with ModelValueError('... holds a !!timestamp'), an exception none of the named refusals produces (narrow.py:38-54 raise only TypeError and three ValueErrors).

concerns.recommendation: Either add a named refusal to narrow_proposal for a before model json_document cannot spell (catch ModelValueError at narrow.py:90 and re-raise with the narrowing wording), or record in the GO3 spec and the contract's 'Narrowing a proposal' section that such a before model is refused by json_document's own error.
concerns.title: narrow_proposal escapes with ModelValueError on a before model outside the JSON data model

evidence.observation: Verbatim: "| D6 | GO5's summary binds every artifact by its own identity and keeps the host's text unstripped | review GO3–GO5 F4, F5 | the evolution contract \"Round summary\" |". The binding of outcome rows to the proposal's operations is weaker than GO3's: round_summary (src/gnd/evolve/summary.py:143-147) refuses rows whose "row.operation_index != position or row.operation_id != operation.operation_id" but never compares row.reference, while narrow_proposal (src/gnd/discover/narrow.py:49-54) refuses unless "row.reference != operation.locator.reference()" also fails to hold, and the contract's Round summary section (evolution-contract.md:467-469) states "rows that are not the proposal's operations, one per operation in order, are refused". The EvolutionOutcomeReport reader validates only ordering (models.py:996-999, _outcomes_cover with operations None), so a report row edited to carry another operation's reference passes into the summary's verdict counts.

concerns.recommendation: Add the reference comparison to the row check in summary.py:143-147 so both new APIs enforce the same documented rule, with a case beside test_r1_f2_outcomes_that_do_not_cover_the_proposal_are_refused (tests/test_go5_round_summary.py:252-255).
concerns.title: round_summary accepts outcome rows whose reference is not their operation's

evidence.location: Section 'Goal and completion predicates', closing sentence
evidence.observation: Verbatim: "The milestone is closed when each phase has its record and the close record cites green focused gates for GO1–GO5, the structure and inventory guards, `uv run ruff check src tests tools`, the component-index check, a drafted reply to each of the two issues, and a close review on the instrument D7 selects." close-results.md cites the focused lane ("the evidence is the named tests, all in the focused lane (936 passed) unless marked"), the per-criterion evidence files and GO5-C4's drafted replies, but names no run of the structure and inventory guards, of `uv run ruff check src tests tools`, or of `python3 scripts/components_index.py changed --base origin/main --strict` at the pull request 261 head; the nearest record it points to (evidence/GO2-GO5/full-lane.md:21-23) says only that the commits after a30b6192 were "run on the focused lane and the guard block, not on the whole lane again", and mentions neither ruff nor the component-index check.

concerns.recommendation: Add the three citations to close-results.md (command, exit code and date for the guard block, the ruff run and the component-index check at the final head), so the close record shows each element the plan's completion predicate lists.
concerns.title: close record does not cite the guard, ruff and component-index runs the completion predicate requires

summary: All three digests match. I read plan r4, close-results.md and close-delta.md, then the code and pages they rest on: src/gnd/model/_parsing.py, src/gnd/evolve/outcomes.py, service.py, cli_service.py, models.py, policy.py, src/gnd/discover/narrow.py, src/gnd/evolve/summary.py, src/gnd/commands/evolve.py, unattended-growth.md, the evolution contract, tests/support/markdown_sections.py and the five named test files. GO1-C1 to GO5-C4 are supported by tests that exist and assert what close-results claims; the cited evidence files exist (t8-ratio.json records 0.31; 002-phase-GO1.md; evidence/GO2-GO5/full-lane.md; notes/issue-replies.md drafts both replies and marks them unreleased). Delta rows check out against the code: D1 (the scope decorates gnd.commands.evolve.handle, commands/evolve.py:206), D2 (the whole-proposal dropped-with closure over the meta-schema walk, outcomes.py:281-371), D3 (policy.py:447-450 refuses any fact-type MODIFY outside provenance.rationale, so rows for an existing fact type route to open_questions), D5 and D6. D4's refutation holds: the additive policy admits every element ADD (policy.py:442-446) and refuses no element addition, so dropped-with needs a refused candidate, which writes no preview and no shape matches; the known-mix fixture README records the split. I read the ff67e11d code no reviewer had seen (narrow.py, summary.py, markdown_sections.py) line by line and probed the guarded-page reader for false passes; it fails closed on hidden, reflowed and retitled rules. Three advisory concerns follow, none blocking: one narrowing escape outside its named refusal list, one unchecked binding field in the summary, and missing close-record citations the plan's completion predicate lists.
